statement: A quantum is a pattern on a carrier's port, and the defect class it sees is 6Y mod 6.
status: Exact decoder of charges and names. It carries no mass, no coupling value and no mixing.

labels.patterns: EXACT: charges, class, representations, anomaly sums, charge conjugation; equal to the certificate on all 32 rows
labels.the_16: DECLARED convention: the 16 is the set of patterns of even degree (Q, u^c, d^c, L, e^c, nu^c)
labels.copies: DECLARED label: the copy changes no charge; the decoder carries no mass and cannot order the copies
labels.bosons: EXACT: charges of the twelve currents and of the register; the register itself is DECLARED (R8)
labels.statistics: EXACT given the premises of the certificate (a spin doublet per quantum, the Gauss law, antisymmetric occupation)
labels.composites: EXACT: colour singlet, class sum, charge, baryon number. Hadron names: names of the quark model in the naming scheme of the Particle Data Group
labels.run: MEASURED counts of the stored run L6; readings from SS and the certificate

copies.note: The copy changes no charge. Three copies per pattern: 32 Weyl blocks per copy (CH).

groups.name: gluons
groups.action: six moves between colour levels and two diagonal generators

groups.name: W
groups.action: W+ moves s2 to s1, W- moves s1 to s2, W3 is diagonal

mixing.photon: the combination of W3 and B with generator Q = T3 + Y; the neutral register component H0 carries Q = 0
mixing.Z: the other combination of W3 and B
mixing.note: The decoder carries no mixing angle and no mass.

bosons.spin_label: integer EXACT; vector with two polarizations taken from GL and X5 (SS table)

not_gauged.note: Moves between a colour level and a weak level change 6Y by 5. They are not among the twelve currents (GL).

higgs.name: H
higgs.status: register DECLARED (R8); boson and spin 0 EXACT given the register (SS)

composites.rule: A set of quanta has a colour singlet component exactly when every colour level is occupied equally often over the set. A colour singlet set has class sum 0 or 3. It is class neutral exactly when it holds an even number of doublet patterns.
composites.no_mass: The decoder carries no masses. Names follow the flavour content; the order of states inside a flavour content is that of the quark model.
composites.names_label: Names of the quark model in the naming scheme for hadrons of the Particle Data Group. Lowest states only: pseudoscalar mesons, baryons of spin 1/2 and 3/2. A content with a top quark has no entry. The table follows the scheme and does not say which states have been observed.
composites.chirality_note: L and R name the handedness of the quark; for an antiquark, of the quark it is the antiparticle of. Class sum 3 is the class of the Higgs register: a left-handed quark with the antiparticle of a right-handed quark is the content of the quark Yukawa term.

primitives.centre_classes_of: a right-handed quark and its antiparticle
a lepton doublet with its antiparticle, or the Higgs with its conjugate
primitives.ss_note: A pair of class-3 bosons. The reading as a lepton with a Higgs is excluded: that set is a fermion.

primitives.centre_classes_of: a left-handed quark and its antiparticle

primitives.ss_note: A pure flux content is a boson and cannot be an antibaryon. An antibaryon is three quanta on a carrier.
A pure flux content is a boson and cannot be a baryon. A baryon is three quanta on a carrier.

primitives.centre_classes_of: a left-handed quark, the antiparticle of a right-handed quark and the Higgs: the classes that meet in a quark Yukawa term
two left-handed quarks and one right-handed quark
the antiparticles of two left-handed quarks and of one right-handed quark
the conjugate quark Yukawa term: a right-handed quark, the antiparticle of a left-handed quark and the Higgs

run.reading: Every content is a set of flux defects. A flux defect is a boson of integer spin, so every content is a boson (SS). The content carries the centre classes of the named particle set and no further quantum number.
run.decomposition_rule: A content with more than three members is split into neutral parts of at most three members, largest number of parts first. The rule reads classes only; positions on the carrier are not used. DECLARED for display.
